_doc: SEASON-005: the village elder's seasonal tasks. seasons: {spring|summer|autumn|winter: {sets (SEASON-009): [one or more sets of exactly 3 {id (unique across all sets), text (non-empty), kind, target, count (int 1..5)}]; the year's set is sets[(year - 1) % sets.size()] via SeasonTasks.tasks_for; a season may use `tasks` (exactly 3) instead, meaning one set], payout: {stones (int >= 0), renown (int >= 0, in Qingshi Village), favor_all (int >= 0, favor with every villager of Qingshi Village), item (optional items.json id, one given)}}}. kind: catch (target = an items.json fish id; counts fish caught), gather (target = an items.json id; counts units gathered or foraged), hunt (target = an enemies.json id; counts wins), contest (target = a world_events.json id with a contest; counts entries), sell_wanted (target ''; counts units sold to a market's wanted-item bonus). restoration (optional, SEASON-006): {region (regions.json id), name (e.g. "the old shrine"), stages: [1..8 {flag (unique world flag), text}], qi_flag: {flag (unique), bonus (0 < b <= 0.1), text}, incense (optional, SEASON-007): {item (items.json id), flag (unique world flag), days (int 1..3), bonus (0 < b <= 0.1), text (non-empty)}}: each season whose three tasks are finished (CharacterData.seasons_completed, unique season keys) repairs one stage and sets its world flag; when all are reached qi_flag.flag is set too, and the region must list that flag with the same bonus in its qi_flags. Once restored, the shrine takes one `incense` item (SeasonTasks.offer_incense) and sets the timed world flag {until: day + days}; the region must list that flag with the same bonus too. projects (optional, SEASON-008): after the shrine, further village projects in order: [{id, name, region (regions.json id), stages: [1..8 {flag (unique), text}], done_text, fish_bonus (optional, SEASON-011, 0 < b <= 0.1: per stage reached, the fraction of extra catch weight at fishing places of that region, SeasonTasks.fish_bonus), crop_bonus (optional, 0 < b <= 0.1: per stage reached, the fraction of an extra growing day per day for crops in field plots of that region), daily (optional): {item (items.json id), flag (unique timed world flag), text}, gather_bonus (optional, SEASON-015, 0 < b <= 0.2: per stage reached, the chance of one extra unit of the most plentiful item on a gather in that region, SeasonTasks.gather_bonus)}]; finished seasons beyond the shrine fill the next project (SeasonTasks.project_stage); news (optional, SEASON-016): 1+ non-empty village-talk templates ({project}, {subject}, {beast}) a villager may say instead of the generic project_stage pool (70% of the time) while this project's stage is fresh news. SeasonTasks.draw_daily gives one daily item once whole. Progress lives in CharacterData.season_tasks and resets when the season changes; SeasonTasks.note adds to it and pays the reward once when all three are done. recap (SEASON-014): {key: [1..3 template strings, each non-empty and <= 100 chars]} for every line LifeStats.season_summary builds; keys tasks ({done},{n}), fights_won/fights_lost ({n},{s}), fights_mixed ({won},{lost},{s}), great_beast_one, great_beast_many ({n}), harvests/foraged/crafted/missions ({n},{s}), festival_one, festival_many ({n}), breakthrough_one, breakthrough_many ({n}), quiet; {s} is the plural s; one template is picked with the game rng; the first is the default.

The chronicle records {n} great beasts felled by your hand.

stages.text: Villagers clear the weeds and rubble from the old shrine.
A new roof of grey tile goes up over the old shrine.
The old shrine's cracked altar stone is set straight and polished.
Incense is lit at the old shrine for the first time in a generation.

incense.text: Incense smoke curls from the old shrine.

projects.name: the Founder's Old Well
projects.done_line: Old women weep and children cheer as the first bucket rises from the Founder's Old Well.

stages.text: Villagers haul the rotten cover off the Founder's Old Well and bail out the muck.
Masons re-lay the well's fallen stones and hang a new windlass.
Clear water rises in the Founder's Old Well for the first time in a generation.

projects.done_text: The old well is whole: Qingshi's fields grow faster, and you may draw well water once a day.
news: Have you tasted the water from the Founder's Old Well? Sweet as my grandmother's, and cold enough to ache your teeth.
The women queue at the well at dawn now, and nobody minds, because the gossip is as good as the water.
Old Chen swears the well sang when the first bucket came up. The masons swear it was only the windlass.
My melons never grew so fat as since the well was mended. Say what you like, I'll keep drawing water.
The children drop pebbles down the old well just to hear the splash, until the masons chase them off.

daily.text: You draw a bucket of cold, sweet water from the old well.

projects.name: the Village Pond Jetty
projects.done_line: Our jetty stands whole again, friend, and something long-shadowed has come to lurk under its planks.

stages.text: Old Fisher Wen's neighbours pull the rotten planks off the jetty, and every one of them has a story about the fish that got away.
New posts go into the pond mud. The children count each blow of the mallet aloud and lose count every time.
Fresh planks are laid, and the old folk walk out to the end of the jetty just to feel it hold.

projects.done_text: The pond jetty is whole: fish bite more readily at Qingshi's pond, and a pearl-backed rarity has been seen beneath the planks.
news: Have you walked out on the jetty yet? Old Wen says the boards sing under your feet.
The children race to the end of the jetty every morning now. The fish have started to take notice.
The Tian boys caught three bream off the new jetty planks before breakfast.
Wen sits at the jetty's end with his pipe and tells every passer-by the planks were his idea.
Somebody carved a name into the last jetty post. Nobody will own up, and everybody is smiling.

projects.name: the Herb Slope Terraces
projects.done_line: The slope climbs in green steps again, friend, and Lan says every basket comes down heavier.

stages.text: Herbalist Lan and the slope's old women hack the brambles off the terraces, grumbling that their mothers kept them tidier.
Stone by stone the fallen walls go back up. The old women swear each one sits where their grandmothers laid it.
Baskets of dark soil are carried up, and Herbalist Lan plants the first row herself, humming off-key.

projects.done_text: The Herb Slope terraces are whole: the old women say the slope gives freely again, and a day's gathering may turn up a little more.
news: Herbalist Lan came down from the slope with her basket so heavy she had to rest twice. She was grinning like a girl.
The terrace walls hold again; the old women say they laid every stone the way their grandmothers did.
Have you climbed the Herb Slope lately? Green steps all the way up, and the smell of it carries to the square.
Lan hums off-key among her new rows, and nobody has the heart to tell her.
